title: Navigating Life With Reason After Deconstruction

top_liked.text: Bro! That song crazy🔥🔥🔥 I’ve been looking for songs like this.

top_liked.author: @AuroraBoarder1
top_liked.text:
Deconstructing caused me to take on a heavy burden.  When faced with an obstacle,  I no longer have the option of praying.  But I'm finally getting things done!

When I fired Yahweh, I replaced Him with Science.

top_liked.author: @somersetcace1
top_liked.text: I'm sure most if not all of you are familiar with the serenity prayer. I secularized it about 40 years ago. If you can't fix it, live with it. If you can fix, do it. Be honest enough with yourself to recognize the difference. Works for me.

top_liked.author: @DevanHudson
top_liked.text: Agnostic here but pleased there might still be a community for me at Bridge City. Checking it out now! Jalapino. LOL.

top_liked.author: @davethebrahman9870
top_liked.text: Many of my fellow atheists seem to feel a need for ‘community’ after leaving faith, so they jump into fanatical Leftist political beliefs just as irrational as the religious system they rejected.
